row:
Hi! I'm Victoria—a pediatric physical therapist (DPT), educator, and mom of twins, a toddler, and a big kid.

This channel is your go-to resource for baby & toddler development, milestones, movement, and play through practical, evidence-based education.

You'll find:
• Tutorials on rolling, sitting, crawling, walking, torticollis, plagiocephaly, tummy time, and more
• Product reviews, unboxings, and recommendations
• Easy activities for babies and toddlers
• Answers to common parenting questions and milestone myths
• Behind-the-scenes pediatric PT insights
• Family life, travel, and everyday adventures

Whether you're looking for milestone guidance, development tips, product recommendations, or family inspiration, you're in the right place.

⬇️ Developmental guides:
https://stan.store/masteringmthrhd

Disclaimer: Content is for educational purposes only and is not medical advice. Always consult your pediatrician or pediatric physical therapist. Individual evaluation is recommended.
